biggest_catch: You're only paid if Bungii collects from the customer — if the customer's card fails, your pay waits on Bungii resolving it.
catches: Driver Agreement: 'You agree that you are only paid if Bungii is able to collect the payment from the User.'
Same-day payout costs a small extra fee; standard paydays are only Tuesdays and Fridays.
Bungii doesn't disclose its cut — third-party analysis suggests drivers see roughly a third of the customer fee.
More than 2 trip cancellations in 3 months is grounds for termination; all deliveries are 150 miles or less.

c1.evidence: Official bungii.com: on-demand big-and-bulky last-mile delivery; drivers browse, accept, and complete delivery requests in the Bungii Driver app.

c2.evidence: Official Driver Agreement: 'Your acceptance of a Delivery request with the associated driver earnings will constitute your acceptance of the Service Fee' — per-trip earnings shown at acceptance.

c4.evidence: Official driver FAQ: 'our standard payment dates are Tuesdays and Fridays. For a small fee, you can also set up a same-day payment option.' Bounded timing + same-day option confirmed.

eligibility: Pickup truck (or helper role); smartphone; background check; 1099-NEC at $600+/year.
maximize: Stay online in the app — Bungii's own driver FAQ says online drivers get first trip priority, so you'll earn more simply by being available instead of toggling. Take multi-stop deliveries when offered; Bungii's own resource page says stacking multiple deliveries in a single trip is the key to raising earnings. Stack the driver referral program on top: Bungii pays you for every driver you refer who completes the required deliveries, with the amount listed on your in-app referral page.
notes: Checked 2026-09-23. Official evidence from bungii.com/driverfaq/ + bungii.com/legal/driver-agreement/. Verified: per-trip earnings at acceptance + twice-weekly standard paydays + same-day option for a small fee. Distinct from Lugg/GoShare/Dolly.
payout_quote: Once your account is set up, our standard payment dates are Tuesdays and Fridays. For a small fee, you can also set up a same-day payment option. (bungii.com driver FAQ) | Your acceptance of a Delivery request with the associated driver earnings will constitute your acceptance of the Service Fee. (Bungii Driver Agreement)

repeatable.cadence: Per delivery: accept a delivery request, complete it, get paid on the Tue/Fri payday (or same-day for a small fee), and repeat.

s2.note: No signup fee; same-day option costs a small fee.

s3.note: Tue/Fri standard paydays; same-day available for a fee — today option.

s4.note: No earnings guarantee; Bungii's cut undisclosed.

steps: Download the Bungii Driver app and complete onboarding (background check; onboarded with Branch for payments).
Go online — online drivers get first trip priority.
Browse and accept delivery requests; per-trip driver earnings shown before you accept.
Complete local deliveries (150 miles or less; point-to-point or multi-stop).
Get paid Tuesdays and Fridays, or use the same-day payout option for a small fee.
timing: Standard paydays Tuesdays and Fridays; same-day payout available for a small fee. Payments via Branch.
payout_value_note: variable per-task pay shown in-app before accepting; no fixed amount in official terms
numeric_basis: remediation 2026-09-23: official terms confirm pay mechanism + timing but no fixed amount; set 0-0 variable (R0004 precedent); time defaulted 15-120min active (flagged for review)
who_pays: The delivery customer pays through Bungii — and Bungii's Driver Agreement says you're only paid if Bungii is able to collect the payment from the customer.
who_qualifies: A pickup truck (or the helper role); a smartphone; a background check; you'll get a 1099-NEC at $600+/year.
work_available: Delivery requests appear in the app when you're online; availability depends on customer demand in your market. More than 2 trip cancellations in 3 months is grounds for termination.
what_gets_accepted: Complete the delivery as requested; if the customer's payment fails, your pay waits on Bungii resolving the collection.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No fees. Unpaid time: waiting between deliveries; your truck's fuel and wear. Same-day payout costs a small extra fee.
when_cash_arrives: Standard paydays are Tuesdays and Fridays via Branch. Same-day payout is available for a small fee.
